title: 08. GraphRAG: Complete Comparison & Cheat Sheet
summary: You now have a complete master course on GraphRAG + BM25. Every concept has been covered from mathematical foundations to production code.

sections.title: Master Cheat Sheet
sections.body:
| Concept | Formula / Key | When to Use |
|---------|--------------|-------------|
| **TF** | `count(t,d) / len(d)` | Term importance in doc |
| **IDF** | `log(N / df(t))` | Term rarity in corpus |
| **BM25** | `IDF × TF×(k1+1) / (TF + k1×(1-b+b×len/avgdl))` | Sparse ranking |
| **k1** | 1.2-2.0 (typical: 1.5) | TF saturation control |
| **b** | 0-1 (typical: 0.75) | Length normalization |
| **RRF** | `Σ 1/(k + rank_r(d))` where k=60 | Combine ranked lists |
| **BFS** | Queue-based, depth-first | Wide neighborhood |
| **DFS** | Stack-based, path finding | Specific path queries |
| **Cypher MATCH** | `(a)-[:REL]->(b)` | Graph pattern matching |
| **Cosine Sim** | `dot(a,b) / (‖a‖ × ‖b‖)` | Vector similarity |


sections.title: Key Libraries Summary
sections.body:
```python
# Install everything you need:
pip install \
  rank-bm25          \  # BM25 implementation
  sentence-transformers \ # Dense embeddings
  faiss-cpu          \  # Vector index
  neo4j              \  # Neo4j Python driver
  spacy              \  # NLP entity extraction
  openai             \  # LLM API
  langchain          \  # RAG orchestration
  streamlit          \  # UI
  prometheus-client  \  # Metrics
  redis              \  # Caching
  torch                 # PyTorch (for models)

# Download spaCy model:
python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm
```

> 🎓 **You now have a complete master course on GraphRAG + BM25.** Every concept has been covered from mathematical foundations to production code. Follow the 8-week learning path, build the projects, and you'll have full expertise in modern search and retrieval systems.

**Key Takeaways:**
- 🔵 **BM25** = Probabilistic sparse ranking with TF saturation + length normalization
- 🟢 **GraphRAG** = Encode world knowledge as graph → traverse for richer context
- 🔴 **Hybrid** = BM25 + Vector + RRF = best-of-all-worlds retrieval
- 🟡 **Neo4j** = Purpose-built graph DB with Cypher — pointer-following beats JOINs
- 🟣 **Production** = Cache + Monitor + Rate-limit + Cost-optimize everything
